title: Fylgja twin.json v10 — the twin’s record (M2, M5, M10, M11, M12, 014, 015, 017, 018, 019)
description: Written by the record step into the twin directory after every node is ready; removed with the directory by unstage. Carries the manifest's provenance block (never observed_at from the bundle: D-023), observed_at when the run's input carried a read's time (a create's read, a snapshot's stored take, or an earlier build's check) and an explicit statement that it is unknown when it did not (Constitution VI), the bundle_id, the provisioning run's identity, and the version of the binary that provisioned it. Nothing here is a credential. M5: twin_version is 2, and each node records the artifact it was pushed — name, content type, checksum and size, copied from the staged manifest — and how long its push took. Never the artifact’s bytes. Everything else is v1’s, with M4’s meaning. M7: unchanged (no new key); twin_version stays 2. M10: twin_version is 3, and the record names the waypoint the twin was created from — series, sequence, description and the at’s source — or null when it was created with --branch or from a bundle; provenance.at carries the at itself. Nothing else is new. A waypoint is only ever recorded on a pinned, intent-sourced record. M11: twin_version is 4. The record gains state (ready or diverged), a step block (the last step: outcome, the side it came from and the side it went to or towards, the step run, the phase that failed, containerlab's plan with each touched node's declared and reported link-change behaviour, every push with its outcome, the readiness and push timings, when it started and ended, and the failure's findings) or null for a twin that has not stepped, and nodes[].holds, the bundle_id whose bootstrap and artifact the node is last known to run, or null for a node containerlab restarted, recreated or created that no push landed on, which runs its baseline alone. After a stepped or unchanged step bundle_id, provenance, observed_at and waypoint are the target's; after a diverged step they stay the previous record's and step.to names the target. run stays the create's. A create writes a 4 record with state ready, step null and holds equal to bundle_id on every node. The record is written whole on every path after the step's stage. No device diff, no artifact or bootstrap line, no credential. M12: twin_version is 5. The step block gains wait: how verify's waiting form ended after the record (settled, expired, cancelled or incomplete), the budget, the reads, the seconds from the record until the twin settled or the wait ended, and the assertions still failing at the last read, or null while it has not run. A create writes a 5 record with step null. Nothing else is new. No device diff, no artifact or bootstrap line, no credential. 014: twin_version is 6. waypoint is gone: the record names the stage the twin was created from or stepped to — its proposed change by id and source branch, its label, description and the at's source (given, written, branch_point, head) — or null; step.from.stage and step.to.stage carry the same shape. A create writes a 6 record with step null. Nothing else is new. A record of 5 or earlier reads with no stage. 015: twin_version is 7. The record names the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, the workflow fylgja-rehearse and its run id, or null for a twin no rehearsal created; a step's record keeps it. Nothing else is new. A record of 6 or earlier reads with no rehearsal. 017: twin_version is 8. provenance is the bundle 5 manifest's block, copied verbatim: the branch, the at when pinned, the schema hash, the scope the read was made under (tag:<name>) and the mapping that read it ({reader, model, version}), in place of contract_version. Nothing else is new. A record of 7 or earlier reads with no scope and no mapping: twin show shows it with its scope unknown, twin step refuses it, twin destroy clears it. 018: twin_version is 9. The record names the snapshot the twin was built from or last stepped to, `snapshot_id`, or null for a twin twin provision built, one a following rebuild made, or a record of 8 or earlier, which reads with none; `source` gains `snapshot`, a twin twin create --snapshot built from a stored or sent snapshot, which had no read of a branch; `step.from` and `step.to` may name each side's snapshot, `snapshot_id`, absent where the side's is not known (the from side of an 8 record that stepped). Nothing else is new. 019: twin_version is 10. A stage no longer implies source intent: source says how the twin was created and a step keeps it, so a twin created from a snapshot and stepped to a stage names both. Nothing else is new.

lab.description: The fixed containerlab lab name (Constitution VII).

snapshot_id.description: 018: the snapshot the twin was built from or last stepped to, by its identity in the snapshot store (<state root>/snapshots/<snapshot_id>.json), beside bundle_id; null for a twin `twin provision` built, which had no snapshot, and for one an earlier build's rebuild made, which filed none. Required on source snapshot, null on source bundle. After a stepped or unchanged step it is step.to's, or null when step.to names none; after a diverged step it stays the previous record's. A record of 8 or earlier has no key and reads with none.

bundle_id.description: Identity of the staged bundle (D-024); equals the store entry it was copied from.

provenance.description: Copied verbatim from the staged manifest's provenance block (bundle 5). 017: scope and mapping in place of contract_version.

at.description: Present iff the operator supplied --at; verbatim.

scope.description: 017: the scope the read was made under, tag:<name>, as the CTM envelope records it.

mapping.description: 017: which reader produced the CTM and which version of which model it read, as the CTM envelope records it.

observed_at.description: UTC start of the read that produced this twin's CTM (six fractional digits, as the CTM envelope), when the run's input carried a read's time: a create's, a snapshot's stored take, or a check's; null when it did not (twin provision), in which case observed_at_note says so.

observed_at_note.description: Required when observed_at is null: the explicit statement that the read time is unknown and why (provisioned from an existing bundle; no read took place). Absent otherwise.

source.description: intent: created by `twin create --branch` or `--stage`: the server read and compiled, or an earlier build's rebuild did. bundle: provisioned by `twin provision` from an existing bundle. snapshot: created by `twin create --snapshot` from a stored or sent snapshot: no read (018). How the twin was created: a step keeps it, so a stage twin stepped to a snapshot stays intent and a snapshot twin stepped to a stage stays snapshot (019).

run.description: The provisioning run's identity in Temporal (D-007).

provisioned_by.description: The worker binary that provisioned the twin. Identifies the binary and reaches no bundle (D-024).

recorded_at.description: UTC time the record was written, from the worker's clock. Informational.

nodes.description: One entry per node, sorted by name, as containerlab reported them at deploy and as readiness observed them. M11: after a step, the nodes are containerlab's report after the reconcile; after a reconcile that failed or was cut short, the lab as clab inspect reports it when the record is written (a created node present, a deleted one gone), or the inspection taken before the stage when that read fails; when no reconcile ran, the inspection taken before the stage. Each node's ready_after_s and pushed_in_s are the step's where the step awaited or pushed it, and the previous record's otherwise.

mgmt_ipv4.description: The management address containerlab assigned, without prefix length (containerlab reports ipv4_address as 172.20.20.2/24).

ready_after_s.description: Seconds from the readiness step's start for this node to the probe's first success. M11: after a step, the step's own readiness (step.ready_after) for a node the step awaited; the previous record's value for every other node, or 0 for a created node it lacks.

artifact.description: The artifact pushed to this node: the manifest entry minus its file path. Name and checksum are what twin show, the dry run and every finding name an artifact by. M11: the artifact of the bundle holds names.

pushed_in_s.description: Seconds from the push activity’s start for this node to the node’s commit. M11: after a step, the step's own time (step.pushed[].took_s) for a node whose push landed; 0 for a node that holds null, which runs its baseline alone; the previous record's value for every other node, a node whose push was refused, failed or not attempted included.

holds.description: M11: the bundle_id whose bootstrap and artifact this node is last known to run: the record's bundle_id on a create and on every node a stepped step pushed or left as it was. After a diverged step: the target's on a node whose push landed; null for a node containerlab restarted, recreated or created whose push did not land, which runs containerlab's baseline alone; the previous bundle's on every other node. null and the previous are what the node last ran that the step knows of, not a claim that a push which did not land left it untouched: a push whose step.pushed[].outcome is failed may have committed (a replace that darkens a node), and only refused is the node's own atomic answer. A later rollback reads step.pushed[].outcome beside holds. artifact is the artifact of the bundle holds names (the previous record's entry beside a null).

stage.description: 014: the stage the server resolved and passed to the record step as data (wire.RecordInput.Stage), or null: its proposed change by id and source branch, its label (a mark's, or branch-point or head), its description, and where its at came from: written on the mark (given), the mark's own write stamp (written), the branch's branched_from (branch_point) or the latest stamp plus one microsecond (head). The at is provenance.at, and provenance.branch the branch read: main for a branch-point twin.

rehearsal.description: 015: the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, passed to the record step as data (wire.RecordInput.Rehearsal), or null for a twin no rehearsal created. A step's record keeps it. twin rehearse reclaims a twin whose rehearsal run is no longer running, and refuses every other.

state.description: ready: the twin is at the record's stage and bundle. diverged: the last step failed or was cancelled after the host was touched; the twin is up, step says where it stopped, and it accepts only fylgja twin destroy (M11).

step.description: M11: the last step, or null for a twin that has not stepped. A step is one twin step: from the bundle the record named to one stage of the same proposed change (014).

stage.description: 014: the stage the server resolved and passed to the record step as data (wire.RecordInput.Stage), or null: its proposed change by id and source branch, its label (a mark's, or branch-point or head), its description, and where its at came from: written on the mark (given), the mark's own write stamp (written), the branch's branched_from (branch_point) or the latest stamp plus one microsecond (head). The at is provenance.at, and provenance.branch the branch read: main for a branch-point twin.

snapshot_id.description: 018: the side's snapshot, when it is known; absent on the from side of a step from a record that names none (a record of 8 or earlier)

at.description: the side’s pinned at, verbatim (the stage’s resolved at)

stage.description: 014: the stage the server resolved and passed to the record step as data (wire.RecordInput.Stage), or null: its proposed change by id and source branch, its label (a mark's, or branch-point or head), its description, and where its at came from: written on the mark (given), the mark's own write stamp (written), the branch's branched_from (branch_point) or the latest stamp plus one microsecond (head). The at is provenance.at, and provenance.branch the branch read: main for a branch-point twin.

snapshot_id.description: 018: the side's snapshot, when it is known; absent on the from side of a step from a record that names none (a record of 8 or earlier)

at.description: the side’s pinned at, verbatim (the stage’s resolved at)

phase.description: the phase that failed; null unless outcome is diverged

reconcile.description: containerlab's plan (clab deploy --dry-run --format json) with each touched node's package declaration beside what containerlab reported, and the apply's time; skipped true with no took_s when the plan was empty (its lists empty) or the step was unchanged, whose run applies nothing (its lists still containerlab's plan as read)

declared.description: the node's package's fidelity.link_change; null when the node is created (no package declaration applies)

reason.description: containerlab's node-change-reasons text, when it gave one

took_s.description: the apply, from clab deploy’s start to its return; absent when skipped

outcome.description: landed: the node committed the replace. refused: the node's own answer; a refused replace is atomic, so the node runs what it ran before. failed: no answer settled the push (the node did not answer within push_timeout_s, the heartbeat was lost, or the cancellation reached it, rule run.cancelled), and it may have committed: a replace that darkens a node commits and then times out on every attempt. not_attempted: an earlier phase failed. A later rollback reads this beside nodes[].holds, the bundle last known to run on the node.

rule.description: the finding’s identifier for a refused or failed push

timings.description: a phase not reached is absent

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC, workflow.Now() at the record; the pause at a stage is this to the next step’s started_at

findings.description: the failure’s findings for a diverged step; [] otherwise; never content

wait.description: M12: the step's wait, verify's waiting form run after the record by the VerifyTwin activity, or null when it has not run: the record was just written and the wait is in flight, the run was cancelled before the wait began, or the activity could not write its outcome (the run's result and twin step's document say which). settled: every assertion read from a node held at a read. expired: the budget passed with every node read and an assertion still failing. cancelled: twin destroy (or an interrupt) cancelled the run during the wait. incomplete: the budget passed with a node unread, or the activity itself failed. Record claims (nodes[].holds) are never waited on.

budget_s.description: the budget used: verify's default (120) or twin step --wait

reads.description: reads of the twin made; 0 only for an incomplete wait that read nothing

after_s.description: seconds from `from` to the read that settled, or to the wait's end otherwise

from.description: RFC 3339 UTC: the record's time the budget ran from (step.ended_at)

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC: when the wait ended, the worker's clock

failing.description: the assertions still failing at the last read (verify.host_name, verify.port.enabled, verify.neighbor) and an unread node's operation.failed; [] when settled; never content
